$comment: Seed exercise library for a training app. Tag-based so injury filtering works on movement patterns and joint stress, not on individual exercise names. Add new exercises by tagging them - the filter logic never changes.

schema.id: stable slug - never change once shipped, it's your DB key
schema.name: display name
schema.flags: risk/constraint flags - THIS is what injury filtering reads
schema.unilateral: true if one limb at a time

flags.overhead: arm elevated above head under load
flags.spinal_load_axial: compressive load through the spine (bar on back, standing loaded)
flags.spinal_flexion_loaded: rounding of the spine under load
flags.shoulder_er_end_range: end-range external rotation (e.g. bottom of bench, back rack)
flags.shoulder_impingement_risk: internally rotated elevation, e.g. upright row, lateral raise past 90
flags.wrist_extension_loaded: loaded wrist bent back (front rack, push-up, dip)
flags.grip_intensive: grip fails before the target muscle
flags.ballistic: fast explosive load, harder to abort mid-rep
flags.valsalva_heavy: typically performed with heavy breath-hold - flag for BP/cardiac
flags.prone: lying face down - flag for pregnancy
flags.supine: lying face up - flag for late pregnancy
flags.requires_spotter: failure is dangerous without a spotter
flags.high_skill: technique-dependent, higher injury cost when done badly

injury_rules.$comment: Map user-reported injury to flags/patterns to exclude. Exclusion only - never prescribe. Always offer a same-pattern substitute so the program doesn't end up with holes. Let the user re-enable anything manually.

equipment_inventory.$comment: For a gym-profile feature: user ticks what they have access to, you filter the library. Home/commercial/minimal presets included.

presets.commercial_gym: assume all of cable_and_machines + free_weights + racks_benches + cardio_conditioning
